components.name: Badge
components.intent: Display a compact status or category label. A small, non-interactive pill.

props.name: variant
props.description: Semantic tone. success/warning/error/info map to the four status colours.

components.name: Button
components.intent: Trigger an action in the current context. The primary interactive surface.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual emphasis. primary = main action, secondary = alternative, ghost = tertiary.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size. Affects padding, font, and touch target.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, the button is not interactive and renders aria-disabled.

props.name: loading
props.description: When true, sets aria-busy and blocks interaction. Renders a spinner before the label in default (non-asChild) mode.
